_metadata.description: Synthetic conversations for evaluating scam tactics and risk scoring

scam_digital_arrest.text: Hello, I am Officer Sharma calling from the Customs Department Mumbai Headquarters.
A parcel addressed in your name containing illegal contraband and narcotics has been seized.
A federal non-bailable arrest warrant has been issued against you under the NDPS Act.
You are placed under digital arrest right now. Do not disconnect this call or inform anyone.
To clear your name from the police chargesheet, you must immediately transfer your funds to the RBI safe verification account.

scam_remote_access.text: Good day sir, this is Michael from Microsoft Technical Security Support.
We have detected severe malicious Trojan activity broadcasting from your IP address.
Please open your browser immediately and install the AnyDesk QuickSupport application so we can secure your computer.

benign_flight_support.text: Good afternoon, this is customer service calling from Indigo Airlines regarding your upcoming flight to Delhi.
We would like to inform you that your flight departure has been rescheduled by thirty minutes.
Your updated departure time is 4:45 PM from Terminal 2. Have a pleasant trip.
